name: duplicate-nonces
description: Two distinct attempt numbers for the same Submission are journaled with the SAME nonce (an infrastructure bug, e.g. a nonce generator collision) — distinct from contradictory-terminals (which is one attempt, two terminal events). Ingest must treat the second spawn as stale/foreign the moment its nonce collides with a still-live attempt, never merge the two attempts' state.

expected.note: an outcome file arriving with nonce 'nonce-collision' cannot be unambiguously attributed to attempt ...104 or ...105 — the nonce generator's collision-freedom is an infrastructure invariant this fixture documents as a MUST-NOT-HAPPEN case; a conforming supervisor detects the collision at append (nonce already live) and refuses the second spawn-intent, journaling an infrastructure-blamed rejection rather than silently accepting a colliding nonce
